title: Mara and the Postcard
author: Marguerite Dravenmoor
blurb: Juniper Underhill, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
